# laravelcloud_domains (Resource)

Manages a domain for a Laravel Cloud environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_domains" "example" {
  environment = "environment-id"
  name        = "example-name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) The environment identifier
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `domain` (String) The domain identifier
- `verification_method` (String)
- `verify` (Boolean) Whether the domain's DNS records should be verified and validated.
- `wildcard_enabled` (Boolean)
- `www_redirect` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_domains.example environment-id/the-id
```
